capabilities: import ChatGPT and Claude transcripts from paste, JSON, ZIP, or Markdown
segment conversations into topic-specific notes with auto-generated titles and tags
extract summaries, key points, and reference links into callout blocks
link notes bidirectionally and generate a Map of Content index note
preview, merge, split, and rename segments before creating notes
disambiguation: Not a chat interface or AI assistant; it only processes existing chat transcripts and documents into notes.
extras: Segmentation runs offline with no API keys; optional Ollama enhancement is off by default.
problem: Long multi-topic AI conversations saved as a single transcript are hard to navigate and reuse as connected notes in a vault.

relations.evidence: ChatGPT + Claude support -- paste format, JSON export, and ZIP archives
Optional Ollama enhancement -- use a local LLM for improved segmentation quality

summary: Transcript splitter that breaks long AI chat conversations and documents into topic-specific notes with titles, tags, summaries, wikilinks, and an index note.
